description: This file defines the DynamoDBClientOptions class used for configuring AWS DynamoDB connections in different contexts (clustering, persistence, reminders). It includes properties for credentials and configuration options.

classes.name: DynamoDBClientOptions
classes.description: Configuration class for DynamoDB client options, containing credentials and region/profile settings.

methods.description: Property for accessing the AWS Access Key.

methods.description: Property for the AWS profile name.
